stage.description: Remote resource family being closed: terminal, watch, or process

events.message: Remote session state could not be listed

stage.description: What the state was listed for after a connection opened, e.g. kept_programs

error.description: Remote protocol category returned by server.state on the resumed session

stage.description: Diagnostic collection stage of the ssh or wsl.exe process: reader join or stderr read

error.description: Stable I/O or thread category explaining incomplete ssh or wsl.exe diagnostic evidence

connection.description: Random per-connection log identifier of the forward's session; never a host, user name or session token

stage.description: Controlled remote.forward.accept_failed operation stage; excludes paths and peer input

error.description: Fixed summary and stable failure category from remote.forward.accept_failed; never error display text

connection.description: Random per-connection log identifier of the forward's session; never a host, user name or session token

stage.description: Controlled remote.forward.connection_failed operation stage; excludes paths and peer input

error.description: Fixed summary and stable failure category from remote.forward.connection_failed; never error display text

stage.description: Controlled remote.client.operation_failed operation stage; excludes paths and peer input

error.description: Fixed summary and stable failure category from remote.client.operation_failed; never error display text

connection.description: Random per-connection log identifier that correlates this connection's lines; never a host, user name or session token

transport.description: How the client reached the server: ssh, wsl (a local WSL distribution through wsl.exe), command (any spawned transport chain) or streams (caller-supplied pipes)

outcome.description: How the attempt ended without a failure: connected, or cancelled by the user before the session opened

stage.description: Connection step that failed: probe, artifact, deploy, handshake, authentication, network or connect

server_version.description: Version the remote server reported in server.hello once the handshake succeeded

persistent.description: Whether the server is a persistent daemon session that survives this client disconnecting

resumed.description: Whether this connection reattached to an existing persistent session, i.e. a reconnect

events.message: Remote shell answered the probe for {target}

connection.description: Random per-connection log identifier that correlates this connection's lines; never a host, user name or session token

target.description: Server build target matching the probed system, e.g. x86_64-unknown-linux-musl, or unsupported; authentication has succeeded

connection.description: Random per-connection log identifier that correlates this connection's lines; never a host, user name or session token

target.description: Server build target that was installed or reused, e.g. aarch64-unknown-linux-musl

server_version.description: Version of the bundled server artifact the client offered for this deployment

action.description: Deployment result: reused when the private installed binary already matched, uploaded otherwise

verification.description: How the remote checked the binary: sha256 computed by the host's own tool, or identity (matching size and self-reported identity) when the host has no hash tool

bytes.description: Size of the server binary sent over the connection; present only when it was uploaded

duration.description: Time from sending the install request until the remote confirmed the installed binary

connection.description: Random per-connection log identifier that correlates this connection's lines; never a host, user name or session token

cause.description: Why the server stream ended without a shutdown request: eof, protocol, overflow, or an I/O error kind

duration.description: Time the connection had been established before the stream ended unexpectedly

connection.description: Random per-connection log identifier that correlates this connection's lines; never a host, user name or session token

ended.description: How the session was released: shutdown, closed (stdio server ended with the client), detached (daemon kept running) or lost

duration.description: Lifetime of the established connection from the completed handshake until release

events.message: Port forward started on local port {local_port}

connection.description: Random per-connection log identifier that correlates this connection's lines; never a host, user name or session token

local_port.description: Local TCP port the forward listens on, after the system chose one for port 0

bind_scope.description: Whether the local listener is bound to loopback only or to a network-reachable address

target_kind.description: Remote endpoint family the forward opens: tcp for host and port, unix for a socket path

remote_port.description: Remote TCP port the forward reaches; absent for unix sockets, and the remote host is never logged

target_scope.description: Whether the remote TCP host is a loopback name or address, or another network host

events.message: Port forward on local port {local_port} removed

connection.description: Random per-connection log identifier that correlates this connection's lines; never a host, user name or session token

local_port.description: Local TCP port the forward stopped listening on

connections.description: Number of local connections the forward accepted during its lifetime

duration.description: Time from starting the forward until its acceptor stopped

events.message: Port forward started on host port {listen_port}

connection.description: Random per-connection log identifier that correlates this connection's lines; never a host, user name or session token

kind.description: host when the remote host relays to another server, reverse when connections come back to this machine

listen_port.description: TCP port the remote host listens on, after the system chose one for port 0

bind_scope.description: Whether the host listener is bound to loopback only or to every interface

target_port.description: TCP port a host forward relays to; absent for reverse forwards, and the target host is never logged

target_scope.description: Whether a host forward's target is a loopback name or address, or another network host

local_port.description: Loopback port on this machine a reverse forward connects to; absent for host forwards

events.message: Port forward on host port {listen_port} removed

connection.description: Random per-connection log identifier that correlates this connection's lines; never a host, user name or session token

listen_port.description: TCP port the remote host stopped listening on

connections.description: Number of connections the host port accepted during its lifetime

failed_connections.description: Accepted connections that never reached their target

duration.description: Time from starting the forward until the host stopped listening
